caption: The drawing depicts a long, double-breasted overcoat with wide lapels, a nipped-in waist, and full-length sleeves with cuffs. The coat is primarily a light cream color and is covered with a repeating floral pattern consisting of flowers and leaves in various colors, including purple, yellow, red, and green. The coat features buttons down the front and a belt-like band at the waist. A decorative shirt with vertical ruffles is partially visible at the neckline underneath the coat. To the right of the colored rendering, there is an uncolored, line-drawn back view of the same coat, showing the seam lines, the belt at the waist, and the shape of the collar and cuffs. The background is a plain, light beige color.
title: Man's Dressing Gown
